Claim 1 (Currently amended): A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: analyze the network data and identify a malicious network threat using a processor configured to execute instructions; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, wherein the mitigating action is executed based on predefined criteria.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device, wherein the notification is generated in response to the identification of the malicious network threat.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): A method for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: retrieving a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain using a processor configured to execute instructions; analyzing the network data and identify a malicious network threat; and performing a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, wherein the mitigating action is executed based on predefined criteria.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The method of claim 10, further comprising pushing a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device, wherein the notification is generated in response to the identification of the malicious network threat.
